# Analytics Products: Semantic Layers and Conversational Analytics

> Define metrics once as tested code, serve them through a governed semantic layer, and let an assistant answer only the questions it has proved it can answer. SDAIA Academy course DS-408, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 18,152 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Metrics as products](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/day1.md): Define a metric once, as code, with an owner; sessions: One metric, three owners, Metrics as code with tests, Ownership and change control, Certification and deprecation; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/day1.html; about 4,566 tokens
- [Day 2: Design the semantic layer](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/day2.md): Conformed, fast, governed and portable; sessions: Conformed dimensions across areas, Performance and cost, Access rules, Portability; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/day2.html; about 4,375 tokens
- [Day 3: Test the assistant](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/day3.md): Certified questions, context, accuracy and stability; sessions: A certified set for a platform, Which context helps, A scoring harness, Ask it again; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/day3.html; about 4,090 tokens
- [Day 4: Ship and govern](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/day4.md): Serve, safeguard, route and review; sessions: Serving metrics to tools and agents, Safeguards that show their work, Which questions may go to the assistant, Design review; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/day4.html; about 3,785 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a governed analytics product and its design review](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/capstone.md): page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/slides/capstone.html; about 813 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Three collection rates, one certified](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D1_1_collection_rate.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Five metrics as code](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D1_2_metrics_as_code.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: A change taken through review](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D1_3_change_control.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Deprecate in a 40-metric catalogue](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D1_4_catalogue_lifecycle.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Four areas, one customer, one calendar](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D2_1_conformed_model.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Pre-aggregations for the most-asked queries](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D2_2_pre_aggregations.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Three roles and a seeded leak](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D2_3_access_rules.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Export to Ossie, query from SQLite](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D2_4_portability.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: From 44 to 60 certified questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D3_1_certified_set.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Remove one kind of context at a time](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D3_2_context_ablation.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Accuracy and wrong but plausible](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D3_3_scoring_harness.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Three runs per question](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D3_4_stability.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: A protocol server with role-scoped credentials](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D4_1_serve_layer.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Cite the metric, refuse the uncertified](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D4_2_safeguards.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: A routing policy from the evaluation](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D4_3_routing_policy.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Review a peer's product](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-408/labs/D4_4_design_review.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
